bookSubtitle: Fun Maze Activity Book with Cars, Trucks and Easy Vehicle Puzzles
screenFreeText: A fun screen-free activity book for kids.
bookIntroText: Help each vehicle find the finish, follow the maze path, collect checkpoints, and enjoy fun vehicle adventures.
howToFooter: Use a pencil and have fun!
howToLines:
Start at the vehicle.
Follow the maze path.
Collect the checkpoint.
Do not cross the walls.
Reach the finish.
tipText: Tip: Go slowly, follow the path, and have fun!
